info.title: GuardianLink API
info.description:
GuardianLink is a portfolio demonstration built to show engineering work. It is not a real safety service, it does not contact emergency services, and no real person is monitoring it. In a genuine emergency, contact your local emergency number.

Every schema in this document is generated from the Zod schemas in packages/contracts, which are the same definitions the server validates against.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Generated by the client when the countdown starts, not when the request is sent, so a crash mid-countdown still deduplicates on retry. Reusing a key with a different body is a 409.

400.description: Missing or malformed Idempotency-Key, or invalid body.

409.description: The key was used with a different body.
